user.title: Add a Telink BLE mesh
user.description: Meshes currently advertising: {count}. Choose your product to fill in the mesh name and password automatically, or pick Manual entry.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Telink mesh discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Device {address} advertises mesh **{name}**. Choose your product to fill in the credentials automatically, or pick Manual entry.

credentials.title: Mesh credentials
credentials.description: Preset: {preset}. Check the mesh name and password (edit if needed), then choose the command set and light capabilities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to any node of the mesh. Make sure a lamp is powered and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy.
error.invalid_auth: The lamp rejected the mesh name / password.
error.no_devices_found: No Telink device advertising this mesh name is in range.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this mesh is already in progress.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Telink mesh device.

data.write_with_response: Write commands with response (slower, more reliable on some proxies)

error.bad_color_temp_range: The maximum temperature must be greater than the minimum.

options.livarno: Lidl Livarno / Briloner / C by GE (opcodes 0xF0/0xF1)

set_mesh_credentials.name: Set mesh name and password
set_mesh_credentials.description: Moves the selected lamps to another mesh network: each lamp gets the new mesh name and password over its own connection and then leaves this integration entry. Add (or keep) an entry with the new credentials to control them again. Lamps that should keep relaying for each other need the same name, password and long-term key.

mesh_name.name: Mesh name
mesh_name.description: New mesh name, up to 16 bytes.

mesh_password.name: Mesh password
mesh_password.description: New mesh password, up to 16 bytes. Must differ from the name.

long_term_key.name: Long-term key
long_term_key.description: 16-byte key as 32 hex characters. Defaults to the Telink SDK key c0..cf.
